content.title: Broncos to pick 30th in the 2026 NFL Draft
content.text: Skip to main content Advertising Denver Broncos | News Broncos to pick 30th in the 2026 NFL Draft Feb 23, 2026 at 09:25 AM Aric DiLalla Lead writer Copied! ENGLEWOOD, Colo. — In a couple of short months, the Broncos will be on the clock. Denver officially holds the 30th-overall selection in the 2026 NFL Draft, which will begin on April 23. The Broncos earned the 30th selection after advancing to the AFC Championship Game. They will select after the Los Angeles Rams — who advanced to their respective conference championship game — due to their 2025 record. The selection would represent the Broncos' latest first-round pick since taking cornerback Bradley Roby with the 31st-overall pick in 2014. Denver has previously made the 30th-overall pick on two occasions in franchise history. The Broncos selected cornerback Jahdae Barron with their most recent first-round pick. The 2026 NFL Draft will take place in Pittsburgh from Thursday, April 23 to Saturday, April 25.
